goals.title: Tell us about your goals
goals.subtitle: We use your answers to recommend the right teachers.

goals.immigrationHint: Life and work in the U.S.

goals.levelQuestion: How would you describe your level?
goals.testDescription: Four short sections give you a CEFR level from A1 to C2, saved to your profile. You can also skip it and take it later.
goals.saveError: We couldn't save your answers. Please try again.

results.title: Great work, {name}! You're at {level}.
results.estimatedHint: This level comes from your own answer, not from the test. Take the test to get a precise level by skill — it takes about 20 minutes.
results.noLevelTitle: You don't have a level yet
results.noLevelText: Take the level test (about 20 minutes) so we can recommend the right teachers.

levelDescriptions.A1: You understand and use simple everyday words and phrases. Next goal (A2): talk about your daily life, family and work in simple sentences.
levelDescriptions.A2: You can handle simple, routine conversations about familiar topics. Next goal (B1): tell stories, explain your opinions and manage when you travel.
levelDescriptions.B1: You can handle most everyday situations and talk about your experiences. Next goal (B2): speak more fluently in meetings and understand native speakers at natural speed.
levelDescriptions.B2: You speak fluently with native speakers and understand complex texts. Next goal (C1): express ideas precisely and adapt your style to any situation.
levelDescriptions.C1: You use English flexibly for social, academic and professional purposes. Next goal (C2): master nuance, idioms and very natural expression.
levelDescriptions.C2: You understand virtually everything and express yourself with precision and nuance. Lessons will help you keep and polish your English.

results.recommendedSubtitle: Matched on your goal ({goal}), your preferred times and teacher ratings.
results.recommendedSubtitleNoGoal: Matched on your preferred times and teacher ratings.
results.noRecommendations: No teacher matches yet — browse all our teachers to find yours.

reasons.experience: {years, plural, one {# year of experience} other {# years of experience}}

results.correctionsSubtitle: {correct} correct answers out of {total}. Open a section to see each question, the right answer and why.

test.networkError: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
test.title: Let's find your English level
test.resumeTitle: Welcome back — let's finish your test
test.subtitle: The questions get harder as you go and stop when they reach your level, so nobody answers everything. Do your best and don't use a dictionary.
test.retakeText: Your current level is {level}. A new test replaces it with your new result.

sectionHints.grammar: Choose the word that completes each sentence.
sectionHints.reading: Read short texts and answer questions.
sectionHints.speaking: Tell us what you can do when you speak.

test.how2: Your answers are saved: you can stop and come back later.
test.how3: Use headphones or speakers for the listening part.
test.how4: At the end, you see your level and the corrections of every question.
test.notNowText: You can skip the test. We'll use the level you chose as an estimate, and you can take the test anytime from your dashboard.
test.skipText: Your level will be estimated from what you told us. Teachers will check it in your first lesson, and you can take the test anytime from your dashboard.
test.noAudioTitle: Sound isn't available on this device
test.noAudioText: Your browser can't play the recordings. You can skip the listening section — it won't count in your level — or open the test in another browser (Chrome, Safari or Edge).
test.noPlaysLeft: No more plays — answer from what you heard.
test.playsLeft: {count, plural, one {You can play it # more time.} other {You can play it # times.}}
test.listenFirst: Press play to hear the recording. The questions appear when it starts.
test.speakingTitle: What can you do when you speak English?
test.speakingHint: Tick every sentence that is true for you today. Be honest — your teacher will check it in your first lesson.
